resources.title: Data Pipeline Explained: The Warehouse Analogy
resources.description: A one-page diagram walking the full modern data pipeline — object storage as the loading dock, Spark as the processing area, Snowflake as the organized storage shelves, and Power BI/SQL as the analysts querying it — with a glossary of bucket, object, folder, stage, and table (Snowflake's own stage/table vocabulary).

resources.title: Medallion Architecture (Bronze/Silver/Gold)
resources.description: Bronze/Silver/Gold layer reference diagram showing what each layer holds, who uses it, and why the layered pattern exists — data quality, auditability, reusability, scalability, and governance. The same layering dbt's staging/intermediate/marts convention is built on.

resources.title: The Amazon Fulfillment Center Analogy for Spark
resources.description: A full-page reference on how distributed query processing works — clusters, executors, partitions, the query plan, narrow vs. wide operations, joins, caching, and reading an execution plan. The same concepts Snowflake's own query profiler visualizes under a different name.

resources.title: Why Object Storage Still Matters After Data Is in Snowflake
resources.description: Explains why raw files stay in cheap object storage even after they've been loaded into Snowflake — reprocessing, audit/compliance, lineage, replay for new systems, and cost — with the full pipeline shown end to end, including Snowflake's own external/internal stage model.

resources.title: Snowflake Architecture Explained Infographic (1 of 3)
resources.description: A full breakdown of Snowflake's three-layer architecture: the cloud services layer (security, metadata/catalog, query optimization, monitoring, governance), the compute layer (independent, scalable virtual warehouses for ETL, BI, and ML workloads), and the storage layer (compressed, columnar, auto-tuned micro-partitions). Covers how a query actually flows through the platform, the warehouse-building analogy, key Snowflake features (elastic scaling, time travel, zero-copy cloning, secure data sharing, consumption-based pricing), and a real retail-analytics example.

resources.title: Building a Snowflake Data Pipeline Infographic (2 of 3)
resources.description: A step-by-step walkthrough of building a production Snowflake pipeline: extracting from data sources, landing/staging in cloud storage, loading into Snowflake's raw layer, transforming and modeling with SQL/dbt, automating with Streams and Tasks, and delivering to Power BI/Tableau/business users. Includes a real retail sales pipeline example (Bronze/Silver/Gold tables with actual sample data), sample SQL for COPY INTO loading, a sample Task for automated transforms, and the full architecture diagram.

resources.title: Snowflake + dbt: Building a Production Analytics Platform Infographic (3 of 3)
resources.description: Why and how to pair dbt with Snowflake: the modern analytics engineering workflow (ingest into raw Snowflake tables, transform with dbt, land in curated Snowflake tables, consume via Power BI/Tableau/AI), the dbt model layers (staging/bronze, intermediate/silver, mart/gold), a real sales-analytics model example with actual staging/intermediate/mart table data, a sample dbt SQL model, production & governance practices (Git/GitHub, CI/CD, data tests, documentation, lineage, role-based access), and the full end-to-end architecture.
